[EN] Demons aren't like two-headed dogs or slow-walking trees. You go running blithely past them, and they'll cut your throat just to watch you bleed.
[ES] Los demonios no son como perros de dos cabezas o árboles que caminan lento. Pasas corriendo alegremente junto a ellos y te cortarán la garganta solo para verte sangrar.
